reference_curvature.definition: c0 := c_0, the L0 element of the inherited fixed curvature vector

e_l.source: selected Quantize.forward embedding, with existing STE forward value during training

equation.replaces_only: z_E = e_0 + e_1 + e_2 at Iter29 Step6
equation.decoder_consumer: existing decoder receives z as tangent-coordinate input

unchanged: FCCR-1 mapping, inputs, fixed curvature values, and fixed-buffer behavior
quantizer, codebooks, assignments, and existing STE
all existing losses and loss weights
optimizer, Sinkhorn configuration, training schedule, and seed
Stage3 model, data, evaluator, and protocol

mathematical_limits.limitation: The paper's exact cancellation pairs left residual subtraction with reverse-nested aggregation at a shared curvature; Iter29 has heterogeneous fixed curvatures and cross-layer residual transport. No telescope or homomorphism is established for this transfer.

helper_domain_caveats.origin_exp_helper: existing helper projects output to radius (1-eps)/sqrt(c), default eps=1e-6
helper_domain_caveats.origin_log_helper: existing helper clamps the atanh argument sqrt(c)*norm to at most 1-1e-5
helper_domain_caveats.mobius_add_helper: existing helper clamps its denominator from below and does not project the output

checker_contract.fccr_checker_scope: FCCR-1 fields and fixed-curvature source invariants only; it does not check HRA Step6
hra_checker_must_check: both canonical contracts and their linkage
exact S02 operation, L0-L1-L2 leaf order, and right-nested expression
source c_l and target c0 curvature argument roles
Step6 replacement and existing decoder consumer
unchanged scope and absence of forbidden additions
helper-domain caveats and required S08 runtime observations
checker_contract.deliberation_gate_role: independent 2+1 artifact-presence/process gate; not a substitute for either mechanism checker

later_gates.S05: adjudicate single-factor boundary against Iter29 parent; Step6 replacement must be the sole conceptual delta
later_gates.S06: A/B/Judge independently specify implementation; the approved plan must explicitly authorize the Iter31-local HRA checker at scripts/preflight_hra_step6_iter31.py; orchestrator applies the approved implementation once; no shared checker change
later_gates.S07: A/B/Judge audit both contracts, implementation, and checker; run the unchanged FCCR preflight and distinct no-argument HRA preflight separately and record both outcomes; require both passes plus deliberation-gate pass
later_gates.S08: A/B/Judge MVG verifies runtime shape/finiteness/domain, projection/clamp incidence, fixed-curvature invariance and optimizer exclusion, intended model/codebook gradient health, and same-checkpoint/same-batch z-versus-Euclidean-sum direct effect; no numeric activation threshold is specified or may be fabricated
later_gates.S09_STAGE2: not allowed until S05-S08 and all other canonical gates, current identity/path checks, deliberation gate, and root CLAUDE.md section 6 gradient-path check pass
later_gates.S11_STAGE3: separate later canonical evaluation and route adjudication; preserve the S01 protocol without Stage3 model/evaluation changes
